name: Punishments
overview: Scripture reveals that punishments in the Bible encompass a range of severe and varied measures, reflecting the seriousness of sin and justice under God's law. From Cain's lament of a punishment he deemed unbearable (Genesis 4:13-14) to prescribed penalties such as monetary compensation and retributive justice (Exodus 21:22, 24), the biblical text underscores both the gravity of offenses and the authority of human and divine judgment. Punishments include banishment, burning, and execution by hanging, illustrating the tangible consequences of disobedience and wrongdoing in biblical history.
